Matte hardback cover, 26 full-colour pages on 200gsm gloss paper. Nothing prints until you have approved the exact proof. How ordering and delivery work.

Your photo is used once, then deleted.

Your photo goes to our server and to OpenAI only to draw the character, and the original is not stored. Free previews stay in your open browser. If you save a book, we keep its illustrated character, story and order details privately so we can print and post it. Read our privacy notice.

If the book is for a child, you must be their parent or guardian, or have permission from one.

Good questions.

Do I pay before seeing anything?

No. You see their character and one story page first. No card is needed for that.

Will the character actually look like them?

The free preview shows an illustrated character drawn from your photo. Likeness varies, so you can see the result before deciding whether to save their book.

Can I write my own story idea?

Yes. Choose “My idea” and describe what should happen. One clear sentence is enough.

Who can the books be made for?

Anyone. Pick a reading level from ages 3 to 5 up to adult, and we adjust the words, tone and detail.

Can I add a gift message?

Yes. Add a dedication when saving your book, then check it in the final proof.

When will it arrive?

Your full illustrated proof is ready within 7 days of paying. Once you approve it, printing and UK delivery take about 7 to 12 working days. Order by 1 December to have it for Christmas.

How do I pay?

By card, through Ziina, only after you have seen the free preview and chosen a size. We draw the remaining pages after payment, and nothing prints until you have approved the finished proof.
